feedback: Barb’s confession follows the pre-vote contradiction closely and makes the nonexistent recording into an intentional delaying tactic rather than a technical misunderstanding. That feels earned: her admitted room check and the unpowered camera already supplied the relevant opportunity and concealment. The confession newly specifies that she took poison during the preview, but this confirms a feasible inferred step rather than introducing a decisive identification clue. Her final recognition that security trusted the person who created the blind spot lands emotionally. Hugh and Chip’s denials also retain culpability for their separate misconduct instead of erasing their arcs. I would welcome one personal sentence tying Grant’s leverage to her decision, since the explanation emphasizes method more than motive.
